title: The Tent of Coats and One More Coat
youtube_title: The Tent of Coats and One More Coat | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship makes room before it keeps score.
summary: At a schoolyard with a low swing and a circle of stones, Jaleh is just outside the fun, close to a coat tent that could fit one more. Quinn changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Jaleh has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Cousin Pio lets the children solve it.
